subject: APAC safeguard restarts — targeted restart window and rollback plan
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Suzanne Wong <suzanne.wong@clarityhealth.ai>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@clarityhealth.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: APAC safeguard restarts — targeted restart window and rollback plan

Hi Suzanne / Raj,

Quick note from the infra team: we are scheduling a short, staged restart across a subset of APAC inference clusters to deploy a kernel/driver safeguard patch that addresses intermittent NVLink stalls we observed in early May. This is a targeted maintenance action — not a model change — intended to reduce rare token timeouts under sustained cross-GPU workloads.

High-level plan:
- Window (proposed): May 26, 2026 01:00–03:00 AEST (UTC+10) — we will roll across AZs to avoid region-wide impact.
- Scope: customer-facing inference hosts in apac-south1 and apac-southeast1 (rolling, per-pool).
- Expected customer impact: most requests should see no disruption; a small fraction may experience 100–300ms additional latency during a node handoff. We do not expect dropped requests; we will prefer graceful drain where possible.
- Rollback: immediate kernel rollback + automated traffic reroute; fallback model variant (cpu-optimized) available if a rare regression occurs.

Attachments: 1) safeguard_restart_runbook.pdf (runbook + rollback checklist) 2) snapshot-checklist.csv (pre-maintenance snapshot steps) 3) apac-window-ics.ics (calendar invite stub).

Ask from you: please confirm any hard blackout windows for Clarity Health jobs (cron ingestion, nightly exports) between May 25–27 so we can adjust the run order. If you have a strict no-maintenance window, call that out and we will prioritize avoiding your pools.

I will follow up with concrete host lists and the JIRA link.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com

Subject: Re: APAC safeguard restarts — targeted restart window and rollback plan

Thanks, Irene — appreciate the heads up. A couple quick Qs from our side:  

1) Will live inference traffic for our Dedicated pool be moved to another pool during the restart, or will requests queue briefly? We run A/B tests that are latency-sensitive between 01:30–02:30 AEST.
2) Does the rollback plan include preserving KV cache or will the cache be cold after a node comes back? Re-populating large prompt caches would impact our downstream throughput.

Our internal blackout: May 25 23:00–May 26 04:00 AEST (overnight exports and data sync). If you can avoid restarts on our primary hosts during that period, that would be ideal.

I've attached our compliance questionnaire with our standard Qs about maintenance and data custody (see "clarity_maintenance_questions.pdf").

— Suzanne
Head of Platform Engineering
Clarity Health

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Suzanne Wong <suzanne.wong@clarityhealth.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 13:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: APAC safeguard restarts — targeted restart window and rollback plan

Hi Suzanne — quick technical clarifications:

- Traffic handling: we will perform a graceful drain per host (stop accepting new requests, finish in-flight tokens) and shift traffic to healthy hosts in the same customer tenancy where capacity exists. For Dedicated pools with pinned capacity we will route to the next available replica in the same pool; if capacity is constrained we will route to a compatible model-variant in a neighboring pool per the traffic policy.
- KV cache: we will attempt to preserve per-tenant KV caches where possible using our backup snapshot mechanism. The runbook lists a short pre-check that creates a cache snapshot on disk prior to restart; that snapshot is reloaded on service rejoin. We expect most caches to be warm within 5–20 minutes post-restart depending on request patterns.
- Rollback: automated kernel rollback can be triggered from the runbook; failure triggers immediate traffic diversion and alerting to the on-call infra lead.

Mitigation items we will take for Clarity Health specifically:
1) Avoid scheduling restarts on your primary hosts during the blackout you listed (May 25 23:00–May 26 04:00 AEST).
2) Prioritize draining low-traffic hosts first and schedule your tenancy hosts later in the rolling window if needed.
3) We will run the snapshot checklist before any host reboot for your pools.

JIRA for the patch: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1324 — I'll add you as watchers.

Evelyn
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: APAC safeguard restarts — targeted restart window and rollback plan

Thanks for the quick replies, Suzanne — and thanks Evelyn for the details.

Updated plan (short):
- New agreed window for Clarity Health pools: May 26, 2026 01:00–03:00 AEST (moved to avoid your blackout).
- We will run the snapshot-checklist.csv for your tenancy 60 minutes prior to restart and confirm success via Slack channel #ops-clarity.
- If anything looks abnormal during the first AZ roll we will halt the rollout and trigger the automated rollback and traffic diversion.

Action items for Clarity Health:
- Confirm by end of day May 21 that May 26 01:00–03:00 AEST works for you.
- If you want us to test a single host earlier (non-peak dry run), propose a time and we will do a controlled run.

Attachments included again: safeguard_restart_runbook.pdf, snapshot-checklist.csv, apac-window-ics.ics.

I will post the final host list and a minute-by-minute run order in INF-1324 once confirmed. Please ping me directly if you need a shorter or later window — happy to accommodate.

Cheers,
Irene
Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
